appDesc.message: Finds free games on Epic Games Store, GOG, Amazon Luna and Steam, and claims them for you.

resetLogHint.message: Clears this list. It rebuilds on your next visit to each store: games you already have come back as already claimed, not as failures.

undoResetLog.message: List cleared. It rebuilds on your next store visit.

statusNeverRan.message: The watcher has not run yet.

emptyGames.message: Nothing free spotted. The watcher looks on its own and will tell you.

emptyCodes.message: Nothing to redeem. GOG and Microsoft codes obtained on Luna land here, with their deadline.

wishSteamTitle.message: On your Steam wishlist: remove it there, it would come back at the next import

approxFrom.message: Converted from $1, at the ECB rate of $2

tallyNoneTaken.message: Nothing taken by the extension yet

autonomousHint.message: Opens a background tab and takes the offer

includeDlcHint.message: Four times more numerous than games

filtersPreview.message: Of $1 open offers: $2 claimable without you, $3 to handle yourself.

moreStoresHint.message: Watched and notified, never claimed for you: no claim module exists for these.

backgroundLabel.message: Keep watching after the browser closes

backgroundGranted.message: The watch keeps running once the last window is closed, as long as the computer is on.

backgroundOffered.message: The watch runs only while the browser is open. Tick the box above to let it carry on.

backgroundUnsupported.message: The watch runs only while the browser is open. This browser has no way to change that.

predictionLearning.message: Still learning: it needs a few offers per source.

predictionBandTitle.message: Next 24 hours. The brighter a bar, the more often this source drops at that hour.

quietHint.message: Held back, not dropped: they arrive afterwards

reminderLabel.message: Remind me before an offer ends, hours:

countryHint.message: Epic serves its prices and dates for this country. GOG and GamerPower accept no country parameter, so this setting does not change them. Displayed currency follows this choice.

exportIcsHint.message: Offer endings, upcoming offers and codes to redeem, for your phone's calendar. Export again to see later offers: reminders already imported are updated, not doubled.

phoneHint.message: Breakdowns, captchas and awaited games, on your phone. Install the ntfy app, then subscribe to the address below.

phoneCopied.message: Address copied: paste it into the ntfy app

phoneSecretHint.message: On ntfy.sh, anyone who knows the topic name can read your alerts: keep it long and secret. No redeem code is ever sent.

phoneKindSelector.message: $1 changed its page: the extension can't find the button

phoneKindSource.message: The $1 source has been failing for a while

phoneKindSession.message: $1: you're signed out, sign in again in the browser

phoneKindStalled.message: The watch has stopped: open the browser on your computer

phoneKindMuted.message: Your computer is blocking the extension's notifications

phoneWishedTitle.message: A game you're waiting for is free: $1

phoneTestBody.message: The extension's alerts will arrive here.

updateHint.message: Fetches the latest version from GitHub into your folder, then reloads the extension — without waiting for the hourly update. Needs the helper installed by tools\maj-auto.ps1 -Installer.

updateDenied.message: Permission denied: the button needs to talk to the helper installed on this computer.

updateNoHost.message: Helper not installed. In the extension folder, run: $1

updateWrongId.message: The helper does not know this extension. In the extension folder, run: $1

updateNoGit.message: Git is not installed on this computer.

updateNotRepo.message: The extension folder is not a Git clone.

updateModified.message: Nothing done: files were edited by hand in the folder. They are left as they are.

updateBranch.message: Nothing done: the folder is not on the main branch.

updateDiverged.message: Nothing done: the folder's history differs from GitHub. The update log says what to run.

updateNetwork.message: GitHub cannot be reached. Try again later.

updateReloading.message: Version $1 is here: the extension restarts.

updateAfterClaim.message: Version $1 is here. The extension will restart once the current claim is over.

updatePulled.message: Files updated, same version ($1): nothing to reload.

launcherButton.message: Free Games Auto-Claimer: click to open, drag to move

overlayRecurring.message: Given away $1 times since you started following it. This one you can wait for.

overlayMissed.message: Given away once before, and missed. It may come back.

overlayMissedOn.message: Given away once before ($1), and missed. It may come back.

icsCode.message: Last day to redeem the code for $1

icsExported.message: $1 reminder(s) in the file: open it with your calendar

icsNothing.message: Nothing to put in your calendar right now

importNotOurs.message: That file is not an export of this extension.

backupHint.message: Pending codes cannot be rebuilt: a lost code is a lost game.

shortcutsBody.message: 1 2 3 switch tabs. / focuses the search box. Enter opens the first game. Escape clears the search.

redeemUnknownHint.message: No redemption page has been measured for this store yet. Paste the code on the store website.

codesAddHint.message: Paste anything: titles, bullets and blank lines are ignored.

codesNoneFound.message: No key found in that text.

codesAllKnown.message: Every key there was already listed.

footPaused.message: Claiming rests between passes, so it does not restart on every page.

footIdle.message: Open a store: claiming starts on its own.

healthMuted.message: Your system is blocking this extension notifications.

notifyChallengeBody.message: A security challenge is blocking the claim. The tab has been left open.

keepableOnlyLabel.message: Only games with something to keep

keepableOnlyHint.message: Skips free-to-play and permanent freebies: there is nothing to claim

emergencyHint.message: Stops every click and every background tab, at once. Nothing is lost: the catalogue and your codes stay put.

stoppedBanner.message: Stopped. The extension is not clicking anything.

neverThis.message: Not interested — never claim this title

journalSub.message: The last 500 things the watcher did, kept across restarts. A service worker takes its console with it when it stops, so this is the only trace that survives the night.

journalEmpty.message: Nothing logged yet. The watcher writes here on every wake-up.

journalNote.message: Attach the downloaded file to a bug report: it reads in the order things happened.

historySub.message: What went by, taken or missed. Frozen when each offer ended, so it survives the catalogue purge.

historyRate.message: $1% of judged offers ended up on your account. Missed: $2 worth.

historyRateNone.message: Nothing has ended yet. Come back once an offer has run its course.

historyEmpty.message: No offer has ended since this version was installed.

historyNote.message: Read only. Kept for the last 1000 offers that ended.

historyRecurringSub.message: Titles this extension has seen offered more than once. These you can wait for instead of buying.

canaryHint.message: This store most likely changed its page. Claiming is retried on a backoff; the message above names what the engine could not find.

teachAsk.message: Which button should have been clicked?

teachRefused.message: This label mentions money. It cannot be learned.

syncCodesHint.message: Copies them to your browser account, so a reinstall gets them back. Nothing else is copied.

syncLibraryLabel.message: Recognise my claimed games on my other computers

syncLibraryHint.message: Copies the name and store of each claimed game into your browser account, so another computer does not reopen what is already taken. Turn it on on each computer; turning it off removes the copy.

syncLibraryState.message: $1 game(s) shared with your other computers

syncUnavailable.message: This browser has no sync storage available.

sentinelSub.message: One or more discovery sources have failed three times in a row. While this tab is open, it retries them on a reliable clock — which the background watcher cannot do, because three failures put a source to sleep for hours. Close the tab and everything returns to normal.

sentinelNote.message: This never becomes the default mode. Nothing here suspends the ordinary watch, and closing the tab — or the whole browser — leaves nothing behind to clean up.

sentinelRecovered.message: $1 is back. The ordinary watch is enough again — you can close this tab.

sentinelNothingFailing.message: No source is failing. Nothing to force, and nothing is being requested.

sentinelBannerHint.message: After three failures a source sleeps for hours. The fallback tab retries it while you watch.

collectionSub.message: Everything you own on Steam, GOG and Epic, read with your own session and read-only, plus what the extension claimed. Nothing leaves your browser, and nothing is read until you ask.

collectionStateLoggedOut.message: Not signed in: sign in, then import again.

collectionStateShape.message: Unexpected answer: copy the report and send it, it will say what changed.

collectionKept.message: The list from $1 is still shown.

collectionAmazonState.message: Only what the extension claimed: Amazon's own library is not read yet.

collectionEmpty.message: Nothing yet: import a store above.

collectionNote.message: Steam: owned games and their public names. GOG: your account's game list. Epic: your order history, free games included (a DLC looks like a game there). A title found on two stores is matched by its name: that is a hint, not proof, and nothing uses it to decide a claim. What a store says you own, however, keeps its offer from being opened again: by exact identifier, never by name.

backlogNothingToTry.message: Nothing is marked to try yet.

steamAutoHint.message: Off by default: Steam's agreement forbids it

steamAutoWarn.message: Steam's Subscriber Agreement (section 4.C) forbids scripts that interact with Steam, and Valve may close an account for it without notice (4.D). The extension only adds offers Steam itself marks free to keep, one per cycle and slowly, but the risk remains whole, and it covers your entire Steam account.
